SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id as author_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.likes, c.status, c.created_at, u.nickname as author_name, p.title as post_title FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN posts p ON c.post_id = p.id WHERE 1=1
AND c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND c.post_id = #{postId}
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
